history.footerNote: Streak paused, not broken. A missed night doesn't erase it — skin doesn't punish one missed day, neither do we.

scan.title: What's on your skin?
scan.subtitle: Paste any ingredient list. Photo scanning is coming soon.
scan.tapBelowToType: Tap below to type the list instead
scan.noCameraNeeded: No camera needed — you can type the list with no connection; you'll just need one to analyse it.

scanConfirm.title: Check what we read
scanConfirm.subtitle: Tap a chip to fix it. Nothing is judged yet.

scanResult.couldntAnalyseBody: We couldn't reach the ingredient database — check your connection and try again. Nothing has been judged; no verdict is shown when the analysis itself fails.
scanResult.cantJudgeYet: We can't judge this one yet
scanResult.coverageBody: We could only confidently read {{read}} of {{total}} ingredients — not enough to judge this product. Type in the ones we missed, or paste the full list again.
scanResult.coverageFootnote: A missing ingredient never silently reads as safe — below {{pct}}% coverage there's no verdict at all.
scanResult.notInDatabase: Not in our database yet — reporting helps everyone.
scanResult.inShortNoFlags: {{lead}}, with nothing flagged in our reference. Generally fine to use.
scanResult.inShortFlagged: {{lead}}. The catch: {{name}} is on the label — {{note}} {{advice}}
